samples.question: The image shows a grid of 7 rows and 8 columns of square cells. In every row exactly one cell is filled with a bright colour; that is the row's anchor. Any other filled cell in that row is dark. Slide each row sideways as a cycle - a cell pushed off one end reappears at the other end - until that row's anchor sits in the leftmost column. Do this for all 7 rows. The dark cells in the remaining 7 columns then match one of these symbols: plus, ex, box, tee, diamond. Which symbol do they most closely match? Answer with one word.
